content: David, Zifʼgi Saúl-oburgwissulid
Zifʼginmalad Gabaa-neggweburse nadmalad, geb Saúlʼga sogdapmalad: —Ar David nega-dulesulidgan-asabin, Haquila-yar-siidgi dukudiiye.
Geb degine, Saúl, Israel-dulemar-abargi, milipaa-sordamar-amisadmala (3,000), Zif-nega-dulesulidganba David-aminaded.
Saúl na e-sordaganmala nega-dulesulidgan-asabin, Haquila-yar-siidgi ambikunonimalad. We-yarde igar-dikarba siid. David nega-dulesulidganba-gudiidgi, Saúl e-balegindaniye wisguargu,
e-sordagan-barmisad, adi, daknamalaga, bia Saúl e-sordaganmala bukwa.

Geb degine, David, bia Saúl na e-sordaganmala-danar-bukwa, ase naded. Geb David daksad, bia Saúl gabe, bia Ner-machi-Abner gabe, degine, bia sordamar-e-dummad gabmoga, bela daksad. Saúlʼdi negabargi maid. E-sordamardi ebiris-bukwad.

Geb degine, David, Het-dule-Ahimelecʼse, degi, Sarvia-machi-Abisaiʼse egichisad. Abisaiʼde, Joab-e-gwenadid. David amarse egichided: —¿Doa anba Saúl-gabmaidse nabie? Abisai abin-sogded: —Ani an beba naoe.
David, Abisaiʼbo a-mutik mosmalad. Geb Saúl negabargi gabmai, degi, e-nono-dukuba eswar-gwichi dakdapmalad. Abner, degi, sordamar-bila-onomaladbo Saúl-ebiris gabmamai dakdapid.
Abisai, Davidʼga sogded: —Emi, Bab-Dummad be-isdarad bega urmaksad. Degisoggua, oburgwega be an-imake. Napagi-mai eswargi irgwen-oburgwar an imakoed, ilagwensaar an saoed.
David abin-sogded: —¡Mer be oburgwe! ¿Ar doa Bab-Jehová-dule-nug-imaksad-oburgwisale, gwen sabsur-odurdaklegosuli? Sabsur-odurdaklegedsegad.
David sogdebalid: —Bab-Jehová dula-maisoggu, na e Saúl-onaglik-saoed. Sulile, e-burgwed-ibagi burgoed. Degisurbalile, bila-ononaidgi burgoed.
¡Bab-Jehová e-dule-nug-imaksad mer oburgwega an-imakena gadin! E-nono-dukuba-eswar-gwichidi, degi, dii-buglugi-siidi be sue. Anmar nae.

Saúl-e-nono-dukuba-eswar-gwichidi, degi, dii-buglugi-siidi David sussunnad, geb agine nadmalad. Dule-wargwensaale David-arbid daksasulid, degi, itossurmarbalid, ar bela negoes-gabmamaid. Ar Bab-Jehová, wemar-mer-atakmalaga, ise-gabar wemar-imaksad.
David yar-baidse obaksad, geb a-yar-birgi gwisgudapid. Degisoggu, Saúl-e-sordamar-bukwadgi nued-bangu gwisgusad.
Geb agine, David, Saúl-sordamarse, degi, Ner-machi-Abnerʼse goted: —¡Abner! ¿Be an-itoge? Abner abin-sogded: —¿Ar doa reyse gorgwichi?
David Abner-abin sogded: —¿Ar bebi Israel-yargi dule-buled gudisursi? ¿Ar ibiga be-dummad-rey be nue-edarbissuli? An bega sogdo, ar dule-wargwen rey-oburgwega bemar-gabmaidse dogapid.

Ar weyob be ibmar-imaksadi, adi, gwen nabiridsulid. ¡Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maid-nuggi, napira an bega soged! Bab-Jehová be-rey-nug-imaksadi, be nue edarbissurmalad-ulale, bemar oburgwilegewilubbinad. Be dakena, rey-e-nono-dikarba-eswar-gwichid, degi, dii-buglugi-siid, ¿bia nade?
Saúl, David-gaya-magar-itosgua, sogded: —Machi-David, ¿ar bee be sunmakgwichi? David abin-imaksad: —Dummad-rey, ani an sunmakgwichi.
Dummad, ¿ar ibiga be an-balegindii? ¿Ar igi an be-imaksa? ¿Ar ibu-ibmar-isgana an imaksa?

Dummadye, an bese wilege, an-sunmaked nue be itogo. Ar Bab-Jehová angi isdar-binsaega be-imaknaile, bitigi an ega ibmar-ukleged-ukoed abingaena gadin. Ar dulemar weyob imakega be-imaknairdi, ¡Bab-Jehová amar-ukabsae! Emi, we-yargi, Bab-Jehová-yargi an-ononanaid. Geb anga sogmalad: ‘¡Bamalad-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemalad-e-nug be odummonae!’
Bab-Jehováʼgi-dikasur-burgwega mer be an-imake. Israel-e-rey, ¿ar ibiga be an-balegindii? Ar andi genyob gued, ibmar-nuedsulid. ¡Ar dule sapurba butu-amidiidyob be an-balegindiid!
Saúl abin-sogded: —¡An begi nosad! Machi-David, gannar be anse dage. Akar bar an be-imakosulid. Emi, bedi wile an-daksad, ar andi dule-binsaed-satedyob gusad.
David abin-sogded: —Dummad, wegi be-eswar an ganiki. Suega be-mai-gwensak be barmidage.

Bab-Jehová dule-e-igar-innikigwad-imakedba, degi, e-innikidaedba, war-wargwengi ega ibmar-ukoed. Ar emi Bab-Jehová anga be-urmaksanad, ar andi Bab-Jehová na dule-nug-imaksad gwen-akar-imakbi gussulid.
Ar igi an be-oburgwebigussuli, deyobi, Bab-Jehová mer an-oburgwemogana gadin, degi, bela bukib-binsaedgi an-ollor-imakbalina gadin.
Saúl ega sogded: —¡Machi-David, bedi dule-nuedid! Bedi ibmar-dummagan imakoed. Bela bega ibmar-nueganbi guoed. A-sorbali, David naded. Geb Saúlʼdi gannar e-negse nonikid.
